$description: Go Vocal design tokens (W3C DTCG). $value is what the code renders now. $extensions.gv.backOffice is a proposed back-office value (from the Augur govocal-tokens.css and the .gv-bo scope, fetched 22 Oct 2026); only the workbench's Proposal page shows it, tokens.css never carries it. Generate with npm run ds:tokens.
